2026_02_NO_BAL.headline: Baltimore loses Flowers as New Orleans tries to keep Shough on schedule
2026_02_NO_BAL.paragraph1: Baltimore will be without Zay Flowers after the receiver was downgraded to out with a hamstring injury, taking a major explosive-play option away from the Ravens. New Orleans is trying to rebound from an overtime loss in Detroit and has been encouraged by Alvin Kamara’s progress after he missed the opener. The Saints need a functional run game to keep Tyler Shough out of long-yardage situations, while Baltimore must redistribute Flowers’ targets without losing the spacing that stresses coverage.
2026_02_NO_BAL.model_rationale: New Orleans needs a credible run game to protect Tyler Shough, while Baltimore must replace Zay Flowers’ explosive-play role without allowing the Saints to tighten coverage.
